description: Warning-only completeness for the commit-pinned GTM iframe /tags producer on its three published region choices. Repeated IDs and custom tag content stay opaque. Auction impression and win callbacks are excluded.

params.name: id
params.description: Repeated tag strings are opaque. Custom values and reused local IDs may contain arbitrary characters or create empty repeated values; no field grammar or multiplicity bound is inferred.

params.name: su
params.description: The GTM source emits the encoded page URL or an empty string.

params.name: sr
params.description: The GTM source emits the encoded referrer or an empty string.

params.name: ts
params.description: The source appends getTimestampMillis, but unescaped custom tag values can create additional arbitrary or empty ts occurrences. Only presence is advised; no value grammar or duplicate-selection policy is inferred.

params.name: ncm
params.description: Optional value emitted by the other-only tag branch; not a global event discriminator.

params.name: cd
params.description: Optional order-status deduplication setting. Custom tag values remain opaque and no cross-tag grammar is imposed.

params.name: method
params.description: The GTM template injects a hidden iframe whose src produces a GET.
